title: When a trial registry outsources its own search: measured defects in the public search of ReBEC
notes: Deposit metadata. Version 1.0.0 was released on 2026-08-25 under concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22102596 (version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22102597). The note previously carried here described a pre-release state -- that no tag existed and the repository was unreleased -- and remained in the published record after the tag, the release and the DOI had all happened; it is corrected here rather than left standing. No DOI is minted without the author's explicit authorization in the turn: the deposit is triggered by a git tag, and no tag exists until that authorization is given. CITATION.cff, codemeta.json and CHANGELOG.md are bumped in the same commit that carries the tag.
